g.text: Rates use the sum of available weeks ÷ that year's DANE population × 100,000. Partial source rows can lower the recorded totals.
Row availability is not reporting completeness. These are descriptive normalized records, not official incidence in a population at risk.
Sources: INS / Sivigila, datos.gov.co/4hyg-wa9d (CC BY-SA 4.0); DANE PPED 2025 population revision; DANE MGN2025 boundaries.
Snapshot: 2026-11-02. Fixed 2025 reference geometry, simplified 500 m; EPSG:9377. Islands remain at their actual coordinates.
33 units = 32 departments + Bogotá. Event 220 (severe dengue) is separate. Source week 53 exists only in 2020. Figure: Brandon Huynh.
No source rows (Bogotá); not a zero
